sectionTitle: Why We Do What We Do

items.title: Observing Clean and Unclean Foods
items.description: We believe God defines what is holy and healthy for His people, and we obey His dietary laws as an act of holiness.

scriptures.text: Thou shalt not eat any abominable thing.
To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.
And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food… she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat.

items.title: Why We Maintain Modesty
items.description: We uphold simplicity and purity in appearance as part of consecration before God.

scriptures.text: Neither shall they shave their heads, nor suffer their locks to grow long; they shall only poll their heads.
He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment.

items.title: Why Men Keep Natural Hair
items.description: We maintain natural, orderly hair in submission to God’s created order.

scriptures.text: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.
Doth not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a shame unto him?

items.title: Why Men Keep Beards at all times
items.description: We preserve the beard as part of God’s created identity for men.

scriptures.text: They shall not shave off the corner of their beard.
It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron’s beard.

items.title: Why We Avoid Mixed Fabrics
items.description: We follow biblical principles of separation and purity, even in dress.

scriptures.text: Thou shalt not wear a garment of divers sorts, as of woollen and linen together.
Neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.

items.title: Why Women Dress Modestly
items.description: We teach modest apparel as an expression of godliness and humility.

scriptures.text: Women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety.

items.title: Why We worship without our Shoes
items.description: Removing shoes shows reverence in holy places.

scriptures.text: Put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.
Loose thy shoe from off thy foot; for the place whereon thou standest is holy.

items.title: Why We Do Not Drink Alcohol
items.description: We abstain from alcohol to maintain holiness, sobriety, and spiritual clarity.

scriptures.text: Be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit.
Nor drunkards shall inherit the kingdom of God.
Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine.

items.title: No Offering of Sacrifices to Ancestors or Spirits
items.description: We worship God alone and reject all forms of idolatry.

scriptures.text: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.
Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils.

items.title: Women Observing Purification After Childbirth
items.description: We follow biblical instruction regarding ceremonial purification after childbirth.

scriptures.text: If a woman have conceived seed, and born a man child: then she shall be unclean seven days.
If she bear a maid child, then she shall be unclean two weeks.

items.title: Women Observing separation during mensturation
items.description: We respect God’s law regarding ceremonial separation.

scriptures.text: She shall be put apart seven days.
Thou shalt not approach unto a woman… as long as she is put apart.

items.title: Why We Do Not Accept Homosexual Practice
items.description: We uphold the biblical definition of sexual purity.

scriptures.text: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind.
Both of them have committed an abomination.

items.title: Why Women Cover Their Heads at all times
items.description: Head covering is a sign of authority and spiritual order.

scriptures.text: Every woman that prayeth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head.

items.title: Why Women Avoid Elaborate Hair Styling
items.description: We promote modesty and inward beauty.

scriptures.text: Let it be the hidden man of the heart.

items.title: Why We Do Not Practice Cross-Dressing
items.description: We preserve God’s distinction between male and female.

scriptures.text: The woman shall not wear that which pertaineth unto a man.

items.title: Why We Keep the Holy Sabbath
items.description: We observe the Sabbath because God created and commanded it.

scriptures.text: God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it.
Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.
The seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work.

items.title: Why We Encourage Open-Air Worship
items.description: God is not confined to buildings.

scriptures.text: God that made the world… dwelleth not in temples made with hands.
